Fate Protocol

[Fate Protocol](https://evm.fate.stability.nexus/) is a decentralized, perpetual prediction market that operates continuously without expiration. It replaces traditional order books with a dual-vault system—where users buy and sell **bullCoins** and **bearCoins**—enabling speculation on market trends in a fluid, always-on ecosystem.
